tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan brjod pa zhing der bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ mdog dmar dmar ba'i byi ru'i lhun mdzes mdzes shing ltar sdug yid 'phrog sku/ /rab 'bar 'bar ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor los kun nas yongs su bskor/ ma lus lus can 'gro ba mtha' dag dag pa'i zhing du 'khrid mdzad pa'i/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gter chen skyabs mgon mgon po 'od dpag med la 'dud/ /zla med ston pa thugs rje'i can khyod kyis/ /bdag sogs ma dag zhing gi gdul bya rnams/ /shi 'phos gyur tshe bde ldan zhing mchog der/ / thugs rje'i lcags kyus nges par drongs shig kye/ /mgon de'i zhing gi bkod pa rnams/ /mdo las 'byung bzhin don gyi gnad/ /phyogs gcig rje yi bshad srol ltar/ /cung zad gus pas brjaud par bya/ /de yang spyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la ni sngon zhing dag sbyor gyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i longs sprul gyi dag pa'i zhing gnyis re yod par gsungs la/ longs sku'i zhing na 'khor byang sems 'phags pa sha stag gis gang ba ma gtogs so skye mi 'byung zhing*/ der ma zad/ sprul sku'i zhing 'ga' zhig na'ang 'khor byang sems kho na dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu so skye yod kyang skye ba'i rgyu sgrub dga' ba dang*/ zhing la lar skyes kyang slar ngan 'gror ltung srid bas dgos pa mi 'grub/ bde ba can dang mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du skye ba'i rgyu sgrub sla bas zhing 'di'i gdul byas bsgrubs na der skye ba la dgongs nas/ ston pas zhing 'di gnyis kyi zhing bkod kyi mdo logs su rgyas par bshad cing*/ mdo sde thar pa chen po las kyang*/ ngas ni mi 'khrugs 'jig rten dang*/ /bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /shin tu rnam dag mthong ba na/ /sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ /ces gsungs la/ /khyad par du mdo dang gzungs kyi rtog pa du ma las phan yon brjod pa'i skabs su bde ba can du skye'o zhes mang du gsungs so/

/des na/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi snying po bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ zhing der skye ba'i rgyu mdo de las gsungs pa ni/ kun dga' bo sems can gang dag kha cig de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams pas yang dang yang du yid la byed pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba mang po dpag tu med pa bskyed pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa yongs su bsngos te 'jig rten gyi khams der skye bar smon lam 'debs pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus su nyer bar gnas pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med dge slong gi tshogs du mas bskor zhing mdun gyis bltas nas bzhugs par gyur te/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med mthong nas rab tu dad pa'i sems kyis shi 'phos te 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong nas rab tu dang ba la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ brjed pa med pa'i dran pas shi 'phos nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs te/ don bsdu na/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med yang yang dran cing mtshan nas brjod pa dang*/ dge rtsa du ma gsog pa dang*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ bsags pa'i dge rtsa rnams zhing der skye ba'i ched du bsngo ba dang*/ zhing der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pas smon lam 'debs pa dang*/ zhing gi snod bcud kyi yon tan bkod pa mdo las bshad pa ltar dran pa rnams te/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni theg chen gyi rigs can du skye ba'i phyir yin la/ gzhan ni thun mong ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /khyad par du zhing de nyid du skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa shugs drag nider skye ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin par bshad cing*/ der ma zad/ zhing der skye ba la gegs byed pa'i nyes ltung rnam bshags pa la yang 'bad dgos so/ /zhing der skyes na dga'o snyam pa la ni zhing gi yon tan shes dgos pas 'dir thog mar zhing gi bsngags pa brjod par bya'o/

/de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ bzang bzang rnam dag zhing mchog der/ /yang yang skye ba'i rgyu de rnams/ /gang gang bsgrubs na de nyid du/ /nges nges skye la the tshom ci/ /zhes pa ni skye ba'i rgyu brjod pa'i skabs so/ /mi mjed zhing nas nub phyogs su/ /sangs rgyas zhing mang 'das pa na/ /bde ba can zhes bya ba yi/ /rmad byung zhing mchog dam pa yod/ /de ni sa gzhi rin chen du mas spras/ /shin tu nyams dga' lag mthil lta bur mnyam/ /rin chen las grub ri bo ma gtogs pa/ /nag po'i ri rnams kun gyis dpen zhing gtsang*/ yid 'ong rnam dag zhing gi mtha'/ rin chen bdun gyi ljon pa dang*/ /ta la'i shing gi phreng ba yis/ /yongs bskor skar mas zla ba bzhin/ /de lta bu'i sa gzhi de ni shing ljon pa rnam pa du mas mdzes par byas shing*/ ljon shing re re la'ang rtsa ba dang yal ga dang lo ma dang 'dab ma dang*/ me tog dang 'bras bu bdun bdun yod pa'i kha cig rtsa ba ni gser/ sdong po ni dngul/ yal ga ni baiḍūrya/ lo ma ni shel/ 'dab ma ni spug me tog ni mu tig dmar po/ 'bras bu ni rdo'i snying po las byas pa dang*/ kha cig ni rtsa ba la sogs pa bdun po rin po che sna re re las byas shing*/ de bzhin du rin po che sna gnyis dang gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug las byas pa dang*/ rtsa ba la sogs pa re re yang rin po che sna bdun ka las byas pa yod do/ /de lta bu la sogs pa'i ljon shing rnams la cod pan dang rna rgyan dang do shal dang gdu bu dang dpung rgyan dang sor gdub dang gser gyi ske rags dang*/ gser gyi dra ba dang*/ mu tig gi dra ba dang*/ rin po che'i dril bu la sogs pa rgyan ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu'i rin po che'i rgyan brgya stong du mas spras pa 'phyang bas sangs rgyas kyi zhing de yongs su gang ba dang*/ snga dro'i dus kyi tshe phyogs bzhi nas rlung langs te/ lha'i spos kyi dri rab tu zhim pa sna tshogs kyis bgos shing kha dog du ma dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i shing ljon pa de dag bskyod cing bskul ba na sil sil gyi sgra dang yid du 'ong ba'i dri bsung dang ldan par 'byung la/

lta na sdug pa'i me tog rnam pa mang po rin po che'i sa gzhi chen po la brul te/ me tog de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing de mi'i bong tshod bdun tsam du khyab par 'gyur zhing*/ me tog de dag ni gos kan tsa lindi ka ltar 'jam zhing reg na bde ba'o/ /de la rkang pa bzhag pa na sor bzhi tsam gyis dma' ba dang*/ rkang pa bteg pa na sor bzhi tsam gyis mtho bar 'gyur ro/ /snga dro'i dus 'das ma thag me tog rnying pa de dag ma lus pa med par 'gyur te/ de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dben pa dang*/ nyams dga' ba dang dag par 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang phyogs bzhi nas rlung langs te sngar bzhin du me tog gsar ba dag 'grel par byed do/ /snga dro'i dus ji lta bar nyin gung dang phyi dro dang srod dang nam gung dang tho rangs kyang de bzhin no/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ gser dngul baiḍūrya dang shel/ /spug dang mu tig rdo snying ste/ /rin chen las grub ljon pa la/ /yid la bsam dgu rgyan bzang 'phyang*/ /shing gi rtsa ba sdong bu yal ga sogs/ /'jam zhing reg na bde ster dri zhim ldan/ /dri yi bzhon pas bskyod tshe rnar snyan pa'i/ /mnyan pas chog mi shes pa'i sgra rnams 'byung*/ /sa gzhi mdzes byed shing gi yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so/ /gzhan yang sa gzhi de ni spos mchog gis yongs su bgos pa'i chu klung rnam pa sna tshogs pas mdzes par byas pas chu rnams kyi zabs su ni dpag tshad bcu gnyis re dang zhing du ni dpag tshad gcig nas brgya stong gi bar yod do/ /de yang 'bab stegs bde ba/ 'dam rdzab med pa/ gser gyi bye ma bdal ba/ lha'i me tog utpa la dang padma dang ku mu da dang padma dkar po la sogs pa dri rab tu zhim pa'i me tog gis khebs pa/ khol khol dag na bya ngang ba dang bzhad dang khrung khrung dang ngur ba dang ka ran da dang ne tso dang ri skeg dang khu byug dang ku na la dang ka la piṅka dang rma bya la sogs pa sgra yid du 'ong ba 'byin pa'i sprul pa'i bya'i tshogs du mas bsten pa/

'gram gnyis ni rin po che'i shing ljon pas gang ba'o/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ zab yangs chu gter chen po ni/ /padma sna tshogs kyis spras shing*/ /skad snyan 'byin pa'i sprul pa'i bya/ /ngang bzhad sogs kyis rnam par mdzes/ /dag pa'i sems can rnams kyi nyer 'tsho'i gzhi/ /yid 'dzin ta ma la dang a ka ru/ /rgya spos tsandan sprul snying gis bgos pa'i/ /nyal 'gro'i rgyun rnams sgra snyan sgrog cing 'bab/ /sa gzhi mdzes byed chu'i yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //༈ gzhan yang sa gzhi thams cad kyang gser gyi dra bas khebs shing rin po che sna bdun gyi padmas gang ba ste/ de yang padma kha cig ni dpag tshad phyed tsam dang kha cig ni dpag tshad gcig dang gnyis nas dpag tshad lnga bcu'i tshad tsam yod de/ rin po che'i padma thams cad las kyang 'od zer bye ba brgya stong phrag drug cu drug cu 'byung zhing 'od zer gyi rtse mo las sangs rgya kyi sku gser gyi kha dog can mtshan dpes brgyan pa bye ba brgya stong phrag drug cu rtsa drug drug byung te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med dpag tu med pa dag tu gshegs nas sems can rnams la chos ston to/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ rab 'byams smon lam las 'ongs pa'i/ /padmo las byung 'od zer rtser/ /rab spros rgyal bas dam chos kyi/ /bdud rtsis gdul bya tshim par mdzad/ /sa gzhi mdzes byed padma'i yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //༈ gzhan yang sa gzhi de ni khang bzang rnams kyis mdzes par byas pa ste/ de yang rin po che sna tshogs kyi ba gam brgya stong gis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i khri lha'i ras bcos bu sna tshogs bting ba la sngas khra bo bzhag pa dang ldan pa'i gzhal med khang du ma dang*/ gzhan yang dar ni spos dang phraing ba dang byugs pa dang phye ma dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang sil snyan dang gos kha dog sna tshogs pa brgya stong du ma ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu'i spos sogs kyis yongs su khyab po/

/de bzhin du spos sna tshogs dri rab tu zhim pa'i ngad ldang zhing dud dus su lha'i spos chu'i sprin gyi char dang*/ lha'i me tog thams cad dang ldan pa dag dang*/ lha'i rin po che sna bdun dang*/ tsandan gyi phye ma dang gdugs rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyi char 'bab pa dang*/ nam mkha' la lha'i phreng ba dang gdugs rnga ma'i bsil yab dang bcas pa 'dzin cing*/ lha'i rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa dang lha'i bu mo dag kyang gar byed do/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ /yid kyi re ba rdzogs byed pa'i/ /'byor bas sa dang bar snang kun/ /yongs gang 'dzin ma'i khyon rnams su/ /ma shong mkha' la bsnyegs pa bzhin/ /sa gzhi mdzes byed rgyan gyi khang pa dang longs spyod kyi yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //༈ de ltar snod kyi yon tan brjod nas bcud kyi yon tan ni/ zhing de'i ngan song gsum dang lha min gyi ris med cing zhing der skyes phyin 'gro ba bzhi po de nyid du slar ldog pa med la mi khom pa gzhan yang med do/ /der ma nges pa dang log pa nyid du nges pa'i sems can med cing thams cad kyang yang dag pa nyid du nges pa sha stag go /smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs pa dus min du 'chi ba yang med cing*/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams ni rin po che'i padma las brdzus te skyes pa sha stag yin la/ 'gro ba ni lha mi gnyis su nges shing de yang lha mi'i tha snyad tsam ma gtogs mtshungs so/ /longs spyod ni gzhan 'khrul dbang byed pa'i lha rnams ji lta ba bzhin no/ /sems can de dag thams cad kyang lus la mtshan so gnyis kyis brgyan pa dang*/ sems kyis skad cig gcig la zhing bye ba khrag khrig sogs su bgrod nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes dang*/ bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig sogs rjes su dran pa'i sngon gnas rje dran gyi mngon shes dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mthong ba'i lha'i mig gi mngon shes dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong sogs kyi sgra thos pa'i lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes dang*/ zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems shes pa'i gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes te mngon shes lnga tshang bar thob pa dang*/ snga dro thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan dag tu phyin nas sangs rgyas stong phrag mang po la mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis mchod nus pa'o/ /'on kyang the tshom za bzhin du skyes pa'i las kyis padma'i sbubs su yun ring du gnas dgos pa rnams la ni mngon shes lnga ma tshang zhing*/ zhing gzhan du de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod du 'gro ba'i nus pa yang med do/ /sems can de dag gis kham zas rags pa mi za yang zas kyi rnam pa ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu'i kha zas dang gos rgyan ji ltar 'dod pa de lta bu rnams bsam ma thag tu rnyed nas gus tshim pa dang rgyan gyis mdzes par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang sngar bshad pa'i chu klung chen po de rnams las lha'i glu dbyangs yan lag bye ba brgya stong dang ldan pa'i sil snyan mkhan mkhas pa rnams kyis byas pa las kyang lhag pa'i sgra snyan cing yid du 'ong ba rnams 'byung zhing*/ de las chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa ci ltar rigs pa ston pa dang sprul pa'i bya'i tshogs rnams kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad chos kyi sgras go bar byed cing des byang sems rnams sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can de dag la sngar bshad pa lta bu'i gzhal med khang ji lta bu 'dod pa de lta bu mdun du byung ste/ de dag gzhal med khangade'i nang du lha'i bu mo bdun stong bdun stong gis bskor nas rtse zhing dga' bar byed do/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ dag pa'i sems can las bzang gis/ /legs sprul lus ni mtshan dpes mdzes/ /yon tan du mas rang rgyud gtams/

/rtag par chos kyi dga' bas 'tsho/ /glog ltar skad cig thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /zhing yang bgrod nas rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru/ / rab 'byams tshogs gnyis bskrun nas slar yang ni/ /rang gi zhing du dga' bdes rol bar mdzod/ /bcud kyi zhing mdzes par byed pa'i yon tan thun mong ba brjod pa'i skabs so// //༈ gzhan yang zhing de'i rgyal ba'i 'khor ni rnam pa gnyis te nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'o/ /de'i nyan thos 'dus pa dang po tsam yang stong gsum gyi skar ma thams cad nyin zhag gcig gis brtsi nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen po mau 'gal gyi bu lta bu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis lo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du las gzhan mi byed par brtsis kyang grangs cha tsam yang chod par mi 'gyur na/ 'dus pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i grangs lta ci smos/ nyan thos grangs med pa de thams cad kyang 'od 'dom gang ba mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa sha stag go /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor ni grangs med cing dpag tu med pa yon tan mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de yang kun la mnyam pa'i byams pa chen po tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ ye shes rgya mtsho chen po dang mtshungs pa/ ting nge 'dzin ri rab dang mtshungs pa/ shes rab nyi zla dang mtshungs pa/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa chu gter dang mtshungs pa/ bzod pa chen po sa dang mtshungs pa/ nyon mongs pa'i dri ma 'khrud pa'i phyir chu lta bu/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i ljon shing sreg par byed pa'i phyir me lta bu/ 'jig rten gyi tshul la mi chags pa'i phyir rlung lta bu/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa khong du chud pa'i phyir nam mkha' lta bu/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i phyir padma lta bu/ chos kyi sgra chen po sgrogs pa'i phyir 'brug sgra lta bu/ chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i phyir sprin chen po dang 'dra ba/ tshogs chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir khyu mchog dang 'dra ba/

sems shin tu dul ba'i phyir glang po che dang 'dra ba/ lus sems mchog tu dul ba'i phyir rta cang shes dang 'dra ba/ mi mthun phyogs la 'jigs pa med pa'i phyir seṅge dang 'dra ba/ sems can gdung pa las skyob pa'i phyir shing n+ya gro dha lta bu/ phas kyi rgol bas mi bskyod pa'i phyir ri rab lta bu/ byams pa chen po tshad med pa bsgoms pa'i phyir nam mkha' lta bu/ dag pa'i chos sgrub pa'i sngon du 'gro ba'i phyir tshangs pa chen po lta bu/ gnas su gsog pa med pa'i phyir bya lta bu/ pha rol gyi sde 'joms pa'i phyir nam mkha' lding lta bu/ 'jig rten na 'byung bar dka' ba'i phyir u dum wa ra dang chos mtshungs shing*/ chos kyi rnga chen po brdung ba/ chos kyi dung 'bud pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba/ chos kyi ba dan 'dzin pa/ chos kyi sgron me 'bar bar byed pa/ sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bsngag pa/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ thos pa rgya mtsho lta bur gyur pa/ rgyal sras re re yang dpag tshad bye ba brgya stong gi 'od dang ldan cing*/ sras kyi thu bo spyan ras gzigs dang mthu chen thob gnyis kyi 'od ni 'jig rten gyi khams de khor yug tu khyab pa'o/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ ye shes rgya mtsho cher gnas shing*/ /snying stobs rgya mtshos go bgos te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ /thos pa rgya mtsho ngoms med tshol/ /ma lus chos tshul tshol la rab tu mkhas/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i gtam gyi snying po rtogs/ /chos kyi gtam la nam yang 'jigs pa med/ /rtag tu sems can grol bar byed la brtson/ /'dren pa'i gtso bo 'od dpag med/ /thub mchog de yi rigs skyes shing*/ /rgyal pa'i gdung 'tshob grags ldan dpa'/ /dag zhing rgyal ba'i sras rnams bsngags/ /de dag ni 'khor gyi nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan phyogs tsam brjod pa'i skabs so//

//༈ de lta bu'i snod bcud kyi yon tan phul du byung ba dang ldan pa'i zhing mchog de'i dbus na byang chub kyi shing gi dbang po chen po 'phang du dpag tshad stong drug brgya yod pa/ yal ga dang lo ma dang 'dab ma rnams dpag tshad brgya brgya tshun chad du 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba'i spom dang khrun dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa/ lo ma dang me tog dang 'bras bu rgyun du 'phyang shing kha dog tha dad pa brgya stong du ma dang ldan pa dang*/ lo 'bras me tog rnams kyang tha dad pa du ma can no/ /zla ba ltar snang ba'i nor bu rin po ches yongs su gsal ba/ rgya mtsho'i nor bu rin po che dang*/ brgya byin gyis thogs pa'i nor bu rin po ches spras shing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches gang ba/ shing de la gser gyi skud pa dang se mo do dang rin po che'i chun po dang do shal chig rkyang dang mu tig dkar dmar gyi phreng ba dang*/ seṅge'i kha nas 'phyang ba'i ska rags dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dra ba dang dril bu g.yer kha dang g.yung drung dang zla gam la sogs pa rnam pa du mas brgyan pa'o/ /byang chub kyi shing de rlung gis bskyod pa na sgra dbyangs 'byung ba des 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa rnams kyang go bar byed la/ gang gis shing de'i sgra thos pa dang mthong ba dang dri tshor ba dang 'bras bu myong ba dang de'i 'od kyis reg pa de thams cad ni byang chub kyi bar du mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus kyi nad mi 'byung ngo*/ /shing de yid la sems pa de dag kyang byang chub kyi bar du sems g.yeng ba can du mi 'gyur ro/ /'di skad ces bya ste/ mang mang bsod nams sa cher las 'khrungs pa'i/ /bzang bzang byang chub shing gi dbang po ni/ /ldem ldem yal ga lo ma 'bras ldan cing*/ /snyan snyan chos kyi sgra dbyangs kun nas sgrogs/ /dgos 'dod 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i gnas/ /ma lus lus can rlongs sel ba'i/ /rin chen chen po sna tshogs dang*/

/rab bkra bkra ba'i gos kyis brgyan/ /de dag ni byang chub kyi shing gi yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //༈ byang chub kyi shing gi dbang po de'i drung na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs te 'tsho zhing bzhes la chos ston to/ /de yang sku tshe bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong 'di snyed cig thub po zhes sku tshe'i tshad kyi mtha' rtogs mi nus pa'i phyir tshe dpag med ces bya la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed rnams ni sku'i 'od kyis khyab cing snang ba'i phyir 'od dpag med dang snang ba mtha' yas zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang gdul bya'i ngo bor 'od 'dom gang ba sogs su ston pa ni srid la/ 'od kyis zhing gzhan dag tu khyab kyang tha mal bas ni mthong mi nus so/ /'od de ni shel gong ltar dri ma med cing nam mkha'i khyon ltar shin tu rgya che ba/ lus la bde ba dang sems la dga' ba bskyed cing*/ gang la rag pa'i sems can rnams ni mchog tu dga' bar byed pa'o/ /de ltar 'od zer gyi phung po chen po mtha' yas shing rol pa'i mtshos gser gyi ri rnams la 'khyud pa bzhin du yongs su bskor ba'i sku'i gzi 'od kyis nyan thos dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor tshogs thams cad zil gyis mnan nas mngon par 'phags te lham me lhang nge lhan ner phyogs kun tu gsal bar snang ba ni ri'i rgyal po ri rab thams cad kyi dbus na mngon par 'phags shing mtho ba bzhin no/ /rgyal ba de'i sku ni bsod nams kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas bskrun pa'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus ni rnam par spras/ ston dus kyi zla ba sprin bral nam mkha'i dbus na rgyu skar tshogs kyis bskor nas lham mer mngon par 'phags pa ltar mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras pa'i sku mchog yon tan tshogs kyis phyung ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor dpag tu med pas bskor ba'i dbus na rab tu brjid cing mdzes pas ni mngon par 'phags/

shin tu dul ba'i khyu mchog ba lang brgya stong gi rjes su 'brang ba dang bcas pa ltar rdzu 'phrul mngon shes sogs kyis rtse ba'i dgra bcom pa'i tshogs kyi ni mdun du bdar/ stobs bcu dang shes bya thams cad la chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i ye shes dang*/ zad mi shes pa'i spobs pa rgyun mi chad pa dang*/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i thugs rje chen po ni rtag tu mnga'/ ri dwags kyi rgyal po seṅgas 'khor gyi tshogs nang du bag tsha ba med par sgra sgrogs pa ltar grangs med pa'i 'khor gyi dbus su mi 'jigs pa bzhis 'jigs pa med par zab cing rgya che ba'i chos kyi sgra chen po ni rgyun mi chad du sgrogs pa ste/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis 'gro ba mtha' dag mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi go 'phang la 'god par mdzad do/ /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ rab 'byams tshogs gnyis las 'khrungs pa'i/ /rab mdzes mtshan dpes spras pa'i sku/ rab dmar byi ru'i lhun po bzhin/ /rab mang 'khor gyi dbus na mdzes/ /bde ba can gyi zhing na 'gro ba'i skyabs/ /ljon shing dbang po'i drung na 'od dpag med/ /rgya chen 'khor tshogs dbus na brjid pa'i sku/ / mtha' yas bsod nams phung po khyod la 'dud/ /rab mtho ri yi dbang po ni/ /rab rgyas zla ba'i bzhin 'dzin cing*/ /rab mdzes utpal sngon po'i mig /rab tu ldan na khyod dang mtshungs/ /'od kyis dpag yas zhing rnams kun tu khyab/ /mkhyen pa'i ye shes shes bya yongs la khyab/ /thugs rje ris bral 'gro la rjes su khyab/ /'phrin las 'jug pa srid mtha'i bar du khyab/ /rab mang 'gro ba 'di kun gyis/ /rab gsal nyi zla'i sgron thogs nas/ /rab tu 'bad de btsal byas kyang*/ /rab mchog khyod 'dra ga la rnyed/ /mi mdzad zhing 'di'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /khyod kyis bsdus nas bdag gis mdzad pa'i phyir/ /khyod zhing yon tan bkod pa rdzogs gyur te/ /zhing 'di snyigs ma lnga yis sbags sam snyam/

/rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing mchis kyang*/ /rab mang snyigs dus 'gro 'di kun/ /rab mchog zhing der 'ongs 'dod kyis/ /rab tu brtse ba'i thugs rjes drongs/ /mang mang 'gro la rjes brtse thugs rje yis/ /mang mang smon lam btab pa'i 'bras smin pa/ /mang mang bde skyid kun gyi 'byung gnas der/ /mang mang gsol 'debs bdag kyang 'khrid cig kye/ /de dag ni zhing gi gtso bo'i yon tan phyogs tsam brjod cing yid kyi re ba gsol ba'i skabs so// //༈ zhing gi yon tan rgyas par ni zhing bkod kyi mdo las shes par bya zhing*/ /de ltar shes par byas nas der skye 'dod kyi 'dun pa yang yang sbyangs pa'i phan yon ni/ mdo de nyid las/ gang gis phra rab rdul snyed 'jig rten khams/ /bshig cing bshags te rdul du byas gyur pa/ /de bas mang ba'i 'jig rten khams rnams ni/ /rin chen bkang ste sbyin pa byin pas ni/ /gang gis 'od dpag med pa'i 'od mtshan dang*/ /bde ba can gyi yon tan khyad 'phags rnams/ /mthong na dga' ste thal mo sbyor byed na/ /bsod nams 'di yi char yang 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes pa nas/ gang gi bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi/ /ming thos pa yi bsod nams de la ni/ /zhing mchog tha gru chen po de dag kun/ /cha dang dper yang 'gyur ba ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa rnams so/ /zhing der skye ba'i rgyu ni gong du brjod pa ltar te/ /de rnams ky-i nang nas mdo dang gzungs kyi rtog pa las gsungs tshul ni/ sman bla'i mdo las/ sman bla'i mtshan brjod na bde ba can du skye ba dang*/ bzang spyod las/ smon lam de brjod na bde ba can du skye ba dang*/ gdugs dkar gyi srung 'khor gyi phan yon gyi skabs su de bsgrags na bde ba can du skye ba dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma'i rtog pa gzungs kyi phan yon brjod pa las/ gzungs kyi cho ga dang gzungs de brjod na bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa lta bu ste gzhan yang mang ngo*/

/der skye ba'i thabs sam rgyu smon lam ni/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bde ba can gyi smon lam rgyas pa yongs grags dang*/ bsdu na/ nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtong ba na/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis dang*/ bzang spyod las/ bdag ni 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa na/ /zhes pa nas/ sems can rnams la phan pa mang bgyid shog /ces pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad bzhi'o/ /tshul 'dir tshul bzhin bdag gis rab 'bad pa'i/ /rnam dkar rnam mang ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /skye zhing skye bar dag pa'i zhing skyes nas/ /myur bar myur du sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di yang shākya'i btsun pa grags pa bshad sgrub kyis dad pas co ne dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo// //maṅgalaṃ//

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan brjod pa zhing der bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 378-- PAGE 377- -PAGE 363-
